scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:integration-database && pnpm run prepare:integration-database && pnpm --filter @workspace/backend test && pnpm --filter @workspace/frontend test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:smoke && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:docs && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/frontend run check:css-size
